title: Fix Sketchpad Detail Panel Field Alignment
description: Analyze and fix the sketchpad detail panel wrong render for selected element piece fields so labels like Attributes, Origin, X Axis, and Y Axis align on the same vertical level as their input fields. Extend existing tests and verify the panel rendering path.
summary: Refactored the sketchpad piece detail panel fix action onto the shared property-row layout so the button now uses the same 22px control surface, width fill behavior, and label alignment as the standard fields. Extended the existing sketchpad Playwright coverage to assert the fix-piece row structure, width/height parity against a normal input, and visibility for a connected child piece selection. Verification: local runtime probing reached the sketchpad/metabolism fixture flow, but the repo Playwright harness is currently blocked by its local preview-server path and workspace TypeScript currently fails on unrelated pre-existing errors in elements/ui and semio/js.
